name: stack
description: A full-screen column for a page with one job (/talk, the kept recording, the permission card): its contents centred, one above another.

children.description: What the page holds, in order.

row.description: A row of controls at the foot, centred (03-talk: Back to today).

places.block: a card or notice: the full column, no margin
places.fill: the recording row: the full width, rounded

states.loading: n/a: a container shows its contents

responsive.1200: the column narrows to 700px, centred (placement, in lock.css)

changelog.change: A row slot: the centred row of controls the screens write as aj-c-stack__row (pages round 2, 03-talk; a page cannot write the class itself).
Writes a main element, as every screen has it (a div before); found by pages round 2, 03-talk.
readout from what it accepts: the readout module is removed (no screen used it).
